sentences.text: Hello and welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
My name is Amelie.
I am happy you are here.
Today we will talk about Burundi.
Burundi is a small country in Africa.
Let's learn about it in simple English.
I will speak slowly.
You can listen and repeat if you like.
Are you ready?
Let's begin.
Where is Burundi?
Burundi is in East Africa.
It is a landlocked country, so it does not have an ocean.
Burundi is next to Rwanda, Tanzania,
and the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
Even though Burundi is small, it has mountains, lakes,
and green hills.
It is a beautiful place.
What is the capital city of Burundi?
The capital city is Jitiga.
Before the capital was Bujumbura.
Now, Jitiga is the capital,
but Bujumbura is still the biggest city.
Many people live in Bujumbura.
It is near Lake Tanganyika,
one of the biggest lakes in the world.
How many people live in Burundi?
About 13 million people live in Burundi.
That is a lot of people for a small country.
Most people live in the countryside.
They live in villages and small towns.
Many people work on farms.
What language do people speak in Burundi?
Most people speak Kirundi.
Kirundi is the national language.
It is used in daily life.
People also speak French and sometimes English.
French is used in schools and government.
Some people speak Swahili too,
especially near the borders.
What is the weather like in Burundi?
Burundi has a warm climate.
It is not too hot and not too cold.
There are two main seasons,
a dry season and a rainy season.
The dry season is sunny and cooler.
The rainy season brings heavy rain.
The weather is good for farming.
People grow bananas,
beans, sweet potatoes and maize.
What does Burundi look like?
Burundi is small but it has many hills and mountains.
It is called the heart of Africa because of its shape and location.
There are green valleys, rivers and lakes.
Lake Tanganyika is very long and deep.
It is home to many fish.
People fish in the lake and swim there.
What animals live in Burundi?
Burundi has many animals but not as many as bigger countries.
In some areas you can see hippos, crocodiles and monkeys.
There are also many birds.
One national park is called Rububu National Park.
It is a good place to see nature and animals.
What do people eat in Burundi?
The food in Burundi is simple and healthy.
Many meals have rice, beans and vegetables.
People eat sweet potatoes, cassava, maize and bananas.
One common dish is Ugali.
Ugali is a thick porridge made from maize flour.
It is eaten with sauce, vegetables or meat.
People also drink banana beer in some areas.
What is life like in Burundi?
Life can be hard in Burundi.
Many people do not have much money but people are strong and kind.
They work hard and care for their families.
Families are very important in Burundi.
People often live together with parents, children and grandparents.
Music and dance are part of the culture.
People enjoy singing and dancing during weddings and celebrations.
Some fun facts about Burundi.
The flag of Burundi is red, white and green.
It has three red stars in the center.
Burundi became independent in 1962.
The money is called the Burundi in Frank.
The national drum is very important.
People play big wooden drums in special events.
The drumming is loud and full of energy.
Now you know many things about Burundi.
You know where it is.
You know the capital, the people, the languages and the food.
You learned about the weather, the land and animals.
You did a great job.
Goodbye for now.
